scientific_integrity: Analytic proof is supplied; numerical diagnostics are finite checks and do not certify the infinite-dimensional theorem. No novelty of Fredholm index or monomial weighted-shift diagonalization is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The log-moment curvature and its derivative obey sign and two-term regular-variation hypotheses. Only integer positive angular winding and one complex variable are treated. The spectral theorem is a self-review; independent mathematical validation and complete historical-priority certification have not been performed.
title: Moment-curvature law for angular Toeplitz self-commutators on radial analytic Hilbert spaces
